title: Caravan
desc: When Sunita's husband tries to kill her, she escapes and tries to reach a friend in Bangalore. Penniless, she unwillingly joins a travelling gypsy caravan and falls in love with the driver Mohan.

title: Mawali
desc: A street-smart hero navigates gang wars, romance, and personal ambition in a chaotic urban setting where loyalty, courage, and quick wit are his weapons.

title: Himmatwala
desc: An honest temple priest bears witness to a murder and gives evidence in a court of law against a powerful landlord in his village.

title: Humjoli
desc: After ditching his lover to marry an heiress, a man proves more than just greedy when he plots his wife's murder and deserts his only child.

title: Aaghaat
